purpose: Create the fifth scaled-agent depth and public-explainability packet set for the fiscal-control overlays: revenue-solvency, payment integrity, and net interest.

overlay_packets.what_it_does: Defines the receipt-base, incidence, distribution, behavior, administration, and interaction evidence required before any effective rate, statutory rate, tax proposal, or balanced-budget claim can be published.
overlay_packets.who_is_affected: Taxpayers, employers, agencies administering receipt systems, programs that rely on general-fund financing, and households affected by tax incidence.
overlay_packets.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Revenue-solvency is not a program-spending lane and is not additive to lane costs. It can later test whether funded requirements reconcile to receipts, but it cannot identify department overspending by itself.
overlay_packets.technology_transition_boundary: Technology may support administration, compliance, filing, audit selection, or burden reduction only after implementation cost, taxpayer burden, agency burden, avoidance, compliance, incidence, and distribution are modeled.
overlay_packets.rate_publication_boundary: Statutory rates cannot be published before matched receipt bases, behavior, incidence, distribution, and administration are modeled. A value calculated after subtracting dedicated receipts is not share of every tax dollar.
blocked_evidence: joint scoring with target outlays and net interest

overlay_packets.what_it_does: Separates improper-payment measurement, confirmed fraud, debt establishment, collections, prevention, control cost, and net savings so public accountability work does not overclaim.
overlay_packets.who_is_affected: Program beneficiaries, providers, agencies, auditors, taxpayers, and parties affected by eligibility, documentation, appeal, collection, and service-delivery rules.
overlay_packets.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Payment integrity is a non-additive overlay. Improper-payment estimates can identify review questions, but they do not become savings credit unless causal prevention or same-cohort collection lineage is established.
overlay_packets.technology_transition_boundary: Technology may support eligibility checks, documentation, anomaly detection, claims timeliness, and recovery administration only after false-positive, access, appeal, due-process, control-cost, and same-cohort outcome evidence is modeled.
overlay_packets.methodology_boundary: improper payments != overpayments != confirmed fraud != recoverable dollars != collected recoveries != net savings
overlay_packets.scoring_boundary: No payment-integrity savings credit is allowed without causal prevention or same-cohort collection lineage. Never infer fraud from an improper-payment estimate.

overlay_packets.what_it_does: Defines net interest as an endogenous result of debt, deficit, maturity buckets, effective rates, interest receipts, and other financing rather than a directly cuttable program lane.
overlay_packets.who_is_affected: Taxpayers, Treasury financing operations, trust funds, general fund accounting, and every lane whose primary-balance changes affect debt and future interest.
overlay_packets.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Net interest cannot be cut directly. It updates only after primary outlays, receipts, deficits, debt, maturity-bucket debt stock, rates, interest receipts, and explicit other financing are recomputed.
overlay_packets.technology_transition_boundary: Technology does not create net-interest savings directly. Any administrative or forecasting tool must pass through explicit primary-balance, debt, maturity, rate, and financing formulas before interest effects are eligible.
overlay_packets.required_recompute_rule: After any primary-balance change, recompute deficit, debt, maturity-bucket debt stock, and subsequent net interest before any solver output is eligible.
blocked_evidence: debt and interest regression test expected values

plain_english_status: Wave 5 publishes fiscal-control overlay depth scaffolds for revenue-solvency, payment integrity, and net interest. Revenue-solvency remains blocked from rates until matched receipt bases, behavior, incidence, distribution, administration, yields, and interactions are modeled. Payment integrity remains non-additive and cannot produce savings without causal prevention or same-cohort collection lineage; improper-payment estimates do not imply fraud. Net interest remains endogenous and cannot be cut directly. This is not a solver run, not target-cost selection, not rate calculation, not a public rate card, not a tax proposal, not a savings estimate, not a waste finding, not a fraud finding, not a department-cut instruction, not a technology-savings claim, and not a balanced-budget claim.
